fields.title: Write criteria
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: Feature: product review summarization. Write items 1, 3, 5, 6 of the section.
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: Task — brief summary of main opinions from product reviews; does not do — does not evaluate the product on behalf of the store, does not answer questions, does not mention specific authors. Quality — all claims backed by reviews ≥ 98%, no author mentions 100%, length within 60–90 words 100%, no store-side evaluative judgments 100%. Fallback — with fewer than 5 reviews, summarization is skipped and reviews are shown as-is. Prohibited — mentioning names, reproducing insults, making medical conclusions.
